decisionsTitle: The feedback page's title loses «(anonim)», and the featured card loses its chip
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-16, two screenshots.** On «Spune-ne ceva (anonim)»: «În momentul care selectez aici „Cu nume și prenume” deja titlul de (anonim) nu prea mai are sens». On the listing's lead card, with its thick primary border and the chips «★ Alergarea principală», «Concurs», «Ediție specială»: «când am „alergarea principală” nu vreau și încă un cip, îmi e suficient acel border».

**Decision, the title (amends §676).** `Tell.title`, the h1 of the form's page and the heading of its door on `/contact`, is «Spune-ne ceva» / "Tell us something" in both catalogues, the suffix gone. It was a promise the page could not keep: the radios beneath it let a person give a name, and a title that says anonymous then contradicts the choice. The reassurance lives where the choice is, in the radios' own «Anonim — Nu ne spui cine ești.» and «Cu nume și prenume — Ca să te putem căuta și să-ți răspundem.», unchanged. The first step's intro said «Anonim, dacă nu alegi să-ți spui numele.», which repeated the word the title lost; it now follows the gate the radios follow (`feedbackFormsNamed`, §678): where the notice in force lets a name be given it reads «Poți scrie anonim sau cu numele tău. Alege despre ce e vorba.» / "You can write anonymously or with your name. Choose what it is about.", and where it does not (no name box, no radios) it reads the new `Tell.introAnonymous`, «Mesajul tău e anonim. Alege despre ce e vorba.» / "Your message is anonymous. Choose what it is about." — the page's meta description follows the same gate — and the form step, which draws no radios then, says «Anonim — Nu ne spui cine ești.» in one line (the radio's own words), so the sentence the old title carried is never lost where no radio carries it `Tell.noticeName`, the name the privacy notice's `{{feedbackForms}}` becomes, was already the title without the suffix (§699) and is unchanged, so an approved notice keeps matching. The email's first line «Nume: (anonim)» (§678) is a different thing — what the message says about its sender — and is unchanged.

**Decision, the chip (amends §470).** The featured card keeps its frame (`featuredCard`: the primary border, its ring and the gradient) and is no longer given the «Alergarea principală» chip: the border says it to the eye and the owner asked for nothing beside it. The accessible mark stays, as visually hidden words in the title's heading, before its link («Alergarea principală:» then the link with the title), not an `aria-label` on the card: a label on a list item is poorly supported, and the card's region is named by that heading (`aria-labelledby`), so it is announced with the region as well; the link's own name stays exactly its visible title (WCAG 2.5.3). The hiding is one clip rule, `SR_ONLY_SX` in `src/shared/ui/sr-only.ts`, never `display: none`; it replaces the three hand-written copies in `GlyphChip`, `EventCheckpoints` and `CardWeather`. The listing's e2e finds a card's title by its exact words, so `listing-filters.spec.ts` allows the lead's hidden prefix. The other chips keep their order and a card that is not the lead is unchanged. The Administrator's tick on the event editor is untouched, and the design page's «marks» row no longer draws a chip the cards do not wear. The star glyph `featured` left the public glyph table (no public file draws it any more; `tests/unit/design/status-chip.test.ts` holds that table to the public surface) and became `cover` in the backoffice's `STATUS_GLYPHS`, drawn by the shop editor's first-picture chip through `StatusChip`, the same star and the same test id.

**Refused:** keeping «(anonim)» on the contact page's heading while the wizard's lost it (one key, one name); a tooltip or a second visible mark for the lead; hiding the words with `display: none`, which removes them from the screen reader too.
changelogLine: - **The feedback page is «Spune-ne ceva», and the lead card has no chip** — the title no longer says «(anonim)» above the choice to give a name, and the featured event keeps its border without a second «Alergarea principală» chip (the words stay for a screen reader). §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criterion 55: the contact page's section heading and the wizard's title read «Spune-ne ceva» / "Tell us something", without «(anonim)» / «(anonymous)»; the first step's intro says one may write anonymously or with a name only where the notice in force lets a name be given, and otherwise that the message is anonymous, the form then saying so in one line; the identity radios (unchanged) carry the reassurance where they are drawn (2026-10-16, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criteria 50 and 72: the featured event's card draws no «Alergarea principală» / «Featured event» chip, its frame (border, ring, background) stays, and the words are visually hidden in its title's heading before the link, so the region named by the title is announced with them and the link's name stays its visible title; every other chip keeps its order and a card that is not the lead is unchanged (2026-10-16, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the feedback page's title without «(anonim)»; the featured card keeps its border and loses its chip
